title: Testing integrator code with libds
preamble:
# Testing integrator code with libds

Patterns and APIs for writing deterministic tests of code
that links libds: mock-clock setup, event-trace
observation, callback wiring for tests, and how to
exercise rule-firing without flake.

## What this is not

- Not a libds-internal test guide. Implementation tests
  for libds itself live at
  `runtime/tests/libds/`;
  conventions for those sit in
  [ITST].
- Not a conformance-test harness spec. Cross-runtime
  conformance is
  [LCON].
- Not a tutorial — assumes you've read
  [NGST] and
  [NLFC].
